requirements.text: Fence delayed heartbeats and distinguish device sessions.
Aggregate active leases and define offline after lease expiration.
Provide snapshot-plus-delta synchronization with explicit gaps.

problem.scope: Track per-device heartbeats, aggregate user availability and distribute authorized transitions. Presence is a bounded-staleness observation, never proof that a person is available.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

references.supports: Lease-backed ownership and transaction revisions, not perfect failure detection.

acceptanceCases.given: Device epoch 3 sequence 8 has an active lease and a second device is connected.
acceptanceCases.then: Old/duplicate heartbeats do not extend its lease; the second active device keeps the user online.
acceptanceCases.when: Deliver epoch 2 sequence 99, duplicate sequence 8, then close only the first device.

acceptanceCases.given: Two devices are active and only one misses its lease deadline.
acceptanceCases.then: The other device keeps the user online; late stale beats cannot resurrect the expired generation.
acceptanceCases.when: Expire that device after rechecking heartbeat version.

acceptanceCases.given: A login cursor predates retained transition history.
acceptanceCases.then: Return resnapshot explicitly and synchronize snapshot plus greater revisions.
